items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And also Ralph Collins and Harold A. John are present to help with the interview.

ctx.x: And also Ralph Collins and Harold A. John are present to help with the interview. Can you tell us just when you were born and just where, what part of this city, if it was right here in town?
I was born April 2nd, 1911 in Madisonville, Louisiana. On the other side of Punchetran Lake.
